final: WITH j AS (SELECT t.transreg AS transreg, tr.tradekind AS tradekind FROM advancedbehavior ab JOIN transactionrecord t ON ab.translink = t.transreg JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg), g AS (SELECT transreg, tradekind, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM j GROUP BY transreg, tradekind), tot AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM j) SELECT g.tradekind, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.cnt * 1.0 / tot.total) AS avg_share FROM g, tot GROUP BY g.tradekind
